dialogue_texts: Heh, I like the sound of that! But you're dead wrong if you think some flashy titles are gonna save you after messing up my night.
You may have bested both of us, but the Order will live on under Flandre Scarlet's rule.
Looks like I'll have to break into the Scarlet Devil Mansion again to see what's cookin'.
The Crimsonite grunts will dance in the capital of your pathetic kingdom.
Let 'em dance until their boots wear out. If any of those Crimsonite pests show up near Kourindou or the Forest of Magic, I'll just blast 'em away with a Master Spark!
Berenice and I are done for...
Lying face down in the dirt suits you two way better. Just stay put while we wrap this up.
Thank you, My Majesty. The Federal Kingdom of Gensokyo at this time is safe.
I don't want 'em cluttering up my paths tomorrow.
I am very and truly pleased. I will attend the festival in Kozankyo.
I am finally happy to be reunited with Fusana. With the Grieg sisters gone, their forest of thorns has disappeared.
Yeah, those thorns were a real pain to navigate through on a broom. Glad to see you two back together, though. Saves me the trouble of a rescue mission!
They can no longer alter their fate, nor even escape and return to their own time.
Messing with time and fate always backfires. If you wanna change things, you gotta do it with your own two hands in the present, not by twisting reality.
Using whatever time we have left, I can finally show you what our nights are like in the mansion.
Have a blast with your mansion party then.
As I remark on the romance between myself and Fusana, our private ball begins now.
